spec.query:
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Berlin")

from(bucket: "smarthome")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "zendure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._field == "solarPower1" or
    r._field == "solarPower2" or
    r._field == "solarPower3" or
    r._field == "solarPower4"
  )
  |> drop(columns: ["domain", "electric", "room"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

charge =
from(bucket: "smarthome")
  |> range(start: -3h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "zendure" and r._field == "outputPackPower")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with joinKey: "x" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "joinKey"])

discharge =
from(bucket: "smarthome")
  |> range(start: -3h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "zendure" and r._field == "packInputPower")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with joinKey: "x" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "joinKey"])

join(tables: {c: charge, d: discharge}, on: ["joinKey"])
|> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: now(),
    _value: r._value_c - r._value_d
}))

from(bucket: "smarthomederived")
  |> range(start: today())
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "daily_energy" and
    (
      r._field == "solarInputPower" or
      r._field == "outputHomePower"
    )
  )
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: ["_time"],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _measurement: "solar efficiency",
      _field: "eta",
      _value:
        r.outputHomePower / r.solarInputPower
  }))

from(bucket: "smarthomederived")
  |> range(start: today())
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "daily_energy" and
    (
      r._field == "solarInputPower" or
      r._field == "outputHomePower" or
      r._field == "gridInputPower" or
      r._field == "green_upstream"
    )
  )
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: ["_time"],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _measurement: "solar use ratio",
      _field: "eta",
      _value: (r.outputHomePower + r.green_upstream - r.gridInputPower) / r.solarInputPower
  }))

spec.query:
from(bucket: "smarthome")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "zendure" and (r._field == "outputPackPower" or r._field == "packInputPower" ))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value:  (if r._field == "packInputPower" then -1 * r._value else r._value) }) )
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _measurement: if r._measurement == "zendure" then "0zendure" else r._measurement}))
  |> drop(columns: [ "room", "_start", "_stop", "domain", "electric"])
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: ["_time"],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )

spec.query:
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Berlin")

from(bucket: "smarthome")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._measurement == "zendure" and r._field == "electricLevel"))
  |> drop(columns: ["domain", "electric", "room"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

import "array"

sensors =
  array.from(rows: [
    {_measurement: "fritz", _value: 0},
    {_measurement: "mystrom", _value: 0},
    {_measurement: "remoteweather", _value: 0},
    {_measurement: "smart-manager", _value: 0},
    {_measurement: "smarthings", _value: 0},
    {_measurement: "tasmota", _value: 0},
    {_measurement: "zendure", _value: 0}
  ])

data =
  from(bucket: "smarthome")
    |> range(start: -6m)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.domain == "heartbeat")
    |> group(columns: ["_measurement"])
    |> count()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _measurement: r._measurement,
        _value: if r._value > 0 then 1 else 0
    }))

union(tables: [sensors, data])
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement"])
  |> max()

from(bucket: "smarthome")
|> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "generosity2")
|> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean)

from(bucket: "smarthomederived")
|> range(start: today())
|> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daily_energy" and r._field == "swm_used" )
|> last()

from(bucket: "smarthomederived")
|> range(start: today())
|> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daily_energy" and r._field == "green_used" )
|> last()

import "array"

sensors =
  array.from(rows: [
    {_field: "Angela", _value: 0},
    {_field: "Georg", _value: 0},
    {_field: "Jonathan", _value: 0},
    {_field: "Emanuel", _value: 0},
    {_field: "Johannes", _value: 0}
  ])

data =
  from(bucket: "smarthome")
    |> range(start: -6m)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.domain == "presence" and (
    r._field == "Angela" or
    r._field == "Georg" or
    r._field == "Jonathan" or 
    r._field == "Emanuel" or
    r._field == "Johannes"
  ))
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> count()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _field: r._field,
        _value: if r._value > 0 then 1 else 0
    }))

union(tables: [sensors, data])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> max()

sun = from(bucket: "smarthome")
  |> range(start: -6h, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "sunforecast" and
      r.dimension == "cc_by_sd" and
      r._field == "sunpredict" and
      r.scope == "FNTM"
  )
  |> last()
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "sun")

battery = from(bucket: "smarthome")
  |> range(start: -6h, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "zendure" and
      r._field == "electricLevel"
  )
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) * 38.0}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "battery")

green_used = from(bucket: "smarthomederived")
  |> range(start: today())
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "daily_energy" and
      r._field == "green_used"
  )
  |> last()
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "used")

green_upstream = from(bucket: "smarthomederived")
  |> range(start: today())
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "daily_energy" and
      r._field == "green_upstream"
  )
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * -1.0}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "upstream")

union(tables: [sun, battery, green_used, green_upstream])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: v.timeRangeStop}))
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: ["_time"],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )

from(bucket: "smarthome")
|> range(start: -3h)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "zendure" and r._field == "electricLevel")
|> last()
